data.name: Matej
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic element mati, meaning 'mother', and tej, meaning 'god'. This name signifies a 'gift from God' or a 'gifted one'.
data.spiritual_meaning: A divine gift, a chosen vessel.

in_hebrew.name: מטיי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם מטיי הוא צורה של השם מתתיהו, שפירושו מתנת אלוהים או מתן מאלוהים. השם נגזר מהמילים העבריות 'מתנה' ו'אלוהים', ומשמעותו היא מתנה מאלוהים לעמו.

in_greek.name: Ματέι
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ματέι είναι μια μορφή του ονόματος Ματθαῖος, που σημαίνει δωρο του Θεού. Το όνομα προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'δώρο' και 'Θεός', και σημαίνει δωρο του Θεού για τον λαό Του.

in_latin.name: Matej
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Matej est forma nominis Matthaeus, quod significat donum Dei. Nomen derivatur ex Latinis verbis 'donum' et 'Deus', et significat donum Dei ad populum suum.

in_english.name: Matej
in_english.long_meaning: The name Matej is a variant of the name Matthew, which means 'gift of God' or 'God's gift'. It originates from the Hebrew name 'Mattityahu', which combines 'mattan' (gift) and 'Yah' (God). In Christian tradition, the name Matthew refers to one of Jesus' twelve apostles, known as the author of the Gospel of Matthew. The name symbolizes a person who is a precious gift from God, bringing light and guidance to others.

saint_reference.note: One of Jesus' twelve apostles and author of the Gospel of Matthew

It is a strong name that traditionally symbolizes respect, compassion, and reverence for one's mother and the divine.

The graceful melody of Matej gently leads its bearer closer to the divine, reminding them of the spiritual potential and power within themselves to thrive and blossom like the mother earth herself.
